purpose: Independent source counterexamples for existing byte claims; evaluation labels do not participate.
reproduction_scope: Two fresh directories per configuration on the same local Wine host; all 64 objects and 64 assembly files are byte-identical. This is not cross-host reproducibility or a hosted CI result.
dependency_verification: Included header bytes were matched to SHA-256-verified Microsoft package payloads. Separate preprocessing dependency reports supplement the initial 14.16/14.29 x64 captures, whose class-layout output interleaved with include tracing.
catalog_limit: Downloaded catalogs were reproducible on refetch but did not match the digest advertised by their channel manifests. Actual catalog digests are recorded. Payload archives independently matched their expected package digests.
